end.summary:
Defined food miles as the distance from where food is grown to the plate.
Compared food miles for imported apples, Shimla apples, and locally grown spinach.
Connected greater distance with greater fuel use and identified buying locally as one way to reduce food miles.
Discussed the route from orchard to plate; teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Rohan practised defining food miles, comparing distances, and suggesting local shopping as a way to reduce them. They explained the method using the journey from the orchard to the plate and linked longer journeys with more petrol or diesel use. They asked for help reading the diagram, so at home you could draw a simple food journey and ask them to label each stop and explain which parts add to the food miles.
